input: Audit all my streaming subscriptions this week

gold.taskTitle: Audit All Streaming Subscriptions This Week
gold.taskDescription: Review every active streaming subscription to assess usage, cost, and whether to keep, pause, or cancel each one.

questions.title: Which streaming categories are you including in this audit?
questions.description: Does this cover video (Netflix, Hulu), music (Spotify, Apple Music), podcasts, audiobooks, gaming, or all of the above?

questions.title: How many subscriptions do you think you currently have?
questions.description: A rough count helps scope the audit — are we talking 3 to 5, or closer to 10 or more?

questions.title: What is your main reason for doing this audit?
questions.description: Is the primary goal to save money, eliminate unused services, consolidate billing, or something else?

questions.title: Do you have a monthly budget target you want to hit?
questions.description: Is there a specific dollar amount you want to stay under after the audit is complete?

questions.title: Are any subscriptions shared with family or a household?
questions.description: Knowing this matters because shared plans affect whether cancelling impacts other people.

questions.title: Where are your subscriptions billed — one card or several?
questions.description: Knowing whether charges are spread across multiple cards, PayPal, or app stores affects how you track them all down.

questions.title: What does a successful audit look like to you by end of week?
questions.description: Should the result be a simple list, a decision made on each service, or actual cancellations completed?
